note: Demo submodule of stripe. Provides SimpleCheckoutForm (form id stripe_examples_simple_checkout) at /stripe_examples/form/simple_checkout, a block SimpleCheckoutBlock (plugin id stripe_example_checkout) that renders it, and StripeExamplesEventSubscriber which subscribes to StripeEvents::PAYMENT and calls setTotal(2500,...) for the example form. Depends on stripe. Medium/hard place/inspect the example checkout block (stripe_ex_probe / stripe_ex_task).

evals.prompt: After enabling the Stripe examples module, at what path can I see the example checkout form, and what is its form id?
evals.expected_output: The SimpleCheckoutForm (form id stripe_examples_simple_checkout) is at /stripe_examples/form/simple_checkout.

evals.prompt: Which block does the Stripe examples module provide to embed its checkout form on a page, and what is the block plugin id?
evals.expected_output: The SimpleCheckoutBlock, block plugin id stripe_example_checkout, renders the example checkout form so you can place it in any region.

evals.prompt: How does the Stripe examples module demonstrate setting the payment amount, and what amount does it set?
evals.expected_output: StripeExamplesEventSubscriber subscribes to StripeEvents::PAYMENT and, for the stripe_examples_simple_checkout form, calls $event->setTotal(2500, ...) - showing server-side control of the amount.

evals.prompt: On this site a block from the Stripe examples module has been placed. Inspect the block configuration and report its block plugin id.
evals.expected_output: The placed block (stripe_ex_probe) uses plugin id stripe_example_checkout (read block.block.stripe_ex_probe).

evals.prompt: Place the Stripe examples checkout block on this site with the machine id 'stripe_ex_task' in the content region of the default theme, and enable it. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a Block config entity id stripe_ex_task with plugin 'stripe_example_checkout' in region content of the default theme, status TRUE, and save. verify checks the block exists, uses that plugin, and is enabled.
